name: Decision log
descriptor: What was decided, from which options, and why — with the ones still open counted in the strip.
verify_checks: decide: the choice is shown on the row
pros: the reason sits next to the decision, which is the only place it is ever read
open decisions are counted, so the log doubles as a to-decide list
the options are kept even after the choice, so you can see what was rejected
it is a plain list: search, sort and export all still work
cons: no voting: the options are text, not tallies
no linking a decision to the record it affected
no superseding: a changed decision is a second record
best_for: a small team's record of why things are the way they are
avoid_if: the decision needs votes or approval steps
